explainer_content.short_definition: Metal and rock rebuilt as machinery: riffs, loops, samples, and controlled abrasion.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Industrial metal put electronic production and heavy guitars into the same pressure system, making machines sound emotional, violent, or seductive.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gave 1990s alternative and metal a new vocabulary for alienation, rhythm, and studio texture.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: Unlike synthpop or house, the machines here are abrasive and guitar-driven rather than purely dance or song-polish tools.
